title: Ambiguous item description -> hand-back to the officer
scenario: The officer asks to reorder 'Portland cement'. The loop matches the text against inventory names itself, finds more than one item, lists them in the hand-off and selects none.

environment.planner: default_plan (deterministic rules; no model call, no API quota used)
environment.clock: run_agent(as_of_date='2026-09-01'): quotation validity judged on that date (a person-set case input passed to the router by code, not a tool argument)
environment.writes: requisition drafts, the loop's tool trace and all audit events written to a temporary folder only; lookup_policy retrieval logging switched off

outcome.message: Which inventory item do you mean? 'Portland cement' matches 2 items: INV-001 (Portland cement 32.5N); INV-002 (Portland cement 42.5N). No item has been selected; please choose one.

plan.message: Which inventory item do you mean? 'Portland cement' matches 2 items: INV-001 (Portland cement 32.5N); INV-002 (Portland cement 42.5N). No item has been selected; please choose one.

persisted_audit_events.outstanding: Which inventory item do you mean? 'Portland cement' matches 2 items: INV-001 (Portland cement 32.5N); INV-002 (Portland cement 42.5N). No item has been selected; please choose one.

observations: The loop asked which item was meant and selected none: zero tool calls, item left as None, reason AMBIGUOUS_ITEM. It did not guess between INV-001 and INV-002 (US-02 AC2).
The hand-off lists the candidates with their names, and they are kept in the case state (item_candidates), so the officer can choose one and resume without starting again (contract section 6).

RESOLVES README finding 8 (12 Oct 2026): matching is done by run_agent(item_description=...) with loop.match_items, deterministic code with no model involved; earlier versions of this trace did the match in the generator and passed item_id=None.
